title: The Chained Devil
text: A devil chained to a pillar, wings torn, begs to be freed in a voice like honey. The chains are inscribed with a warning in a script none of you can read. It promises to show you the way out of the Pit, and it swears on everything it does not have.

options.label: Break its chains, and trust its word.

outcomes.text: It keeps its word, to everyone's surprise, and shows the way out.
It keeps its word, in its own way, which is not your way.

options.label: The shrewdest asks why it was chained.

outcomes.text: It lied to the wrong devil. It tells you who, very gladly.
It curses you as you go, sweetly, by name.
